stock_movements_source_pair_check.name: stock_movements_source_pair_check
stock_movements_source_pair_check.value: ("stock_movements"."source_type" is null and "stock_movements"."source_id" is null) or ("stock_movements"."source_type" is not null and "stock_movements"."source_id" is not null)

stock_counts_confirmation_state_check.name: stock_counts_confirmation_state_check
stock_counts_confirmation_state_check.value: ("stock_counts"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "stock_counts"."confirmed_at" is null) or ("stock_counts"."status" = 'CONFIRMED' and "stock_counts"."confirmed_at" is not null)

idempotency_requests_completed_response_.name: idempotency_requests_completed_response_check
idempotency_requests_completed_response_.value: ("idempotency_requests"."status" = 'PROCESSING' and "idempotency_requests"."response_status" is null and "idempotency_requests"."response_body" is null) or ("idempotency_requests"."status" = 'COMPLETED' and "idempotency_requests"."response_status" is not null and "idempotency_requests"."response_body" is not null)
